$comment: 听力训练营 L21（P-L3 阶段三样课，匹配题型首次投入真课）。脚本 100% 原创；阶段三 · Part 3 观点态度三选一（一段长对话 5 题：为什么选美术班 / 觉得老师怎么样 / 为什么不能踢球 / 觉得象棋怎么样 / 为什么不上烹饪班，观点直说）+ Part 5 匹配（一段长对话，5 个朋友配 8 个课外班 A-H，8 个班全部被提到，3 个是干扰）。词汇 ≥95% 落在 KET A2 词表，超出的词进 warmup。语速 1.0x（真考速度）。
title: Choosing a Club
intro: 阶段三第一课，语速提到 1.0x，和真考一样快。先听 Lucy 和 Sam 商量选哪个课外班，题目问的是「为什么」「觉得怎么样」，答案要听人物自己说的理由和态度；再听 Lucy 告诉爸爸五个朋友各选了什么班，把人和班配起来——8 个班都会被提到，有 3 个没人选。

sections.intro: 听 Lucy 和 Sam 商量这学期选什么课外班。五道题问的是理由和看法，注意每个人自己怎么说。

script.text: Hi Lucy. Have you chosen your club for this term? We have to give the form to Mr Green tomorrow.
Yes, I'm going to do the art club again. I know some people think it's boring, but I love painting. It's the best hour of my week.
You did that last year too. Is it because your best friend is in it?
No, she's doing dance this year. I just like painting, that's all. And the teacher is great. Some people say she isn't very friendly, but she always helps you when you have a problem.
That's good. I wanted to do football, but it's on Wednesdays, and I have my guitar lesson then. So I'm thinking about chess.
Chess? I went to chess club last year. I found it really difficult, you have to think so hard! I stopped after three weeks.
My brother plays, and he says it's easy when you know how to play. He can teach me at home first.
OK. What about the cooking club? It's new this year. My cousin did it at her school and she says it's fun.
I saw the poster. It's on Fridays, which is fine, but it costs five pounds a week because you pay for the food. That's too much for me.
Really? I didn't know that. And the swimming club is free. Are you going to do that as well?
No. The swimming pool is cold in winter, and I don't like getting wet after school. I'll just do chess.
Fine. Let's give our forms to Mr Green together tomorrow morning, before the first lesson.
Good idea. See you at the school gate at half past eight.

questions.q: Why is Lucy going to do the art club again?
options: Her best friend is in it.
She wants to be an artist.
questions.explain: I love painting. It's the best hour of my week——她自己说的理由是喜欢画画。Sam 问是不是因为好朋友，Lucy 说 No, she's doing dance；当画家没有提到。

questions.q: What does Lucy think of the art teacher?
questions.explain: Some people say she isn't very friendly, but she always helps you——「有人说她不友好」是别人的看法，but 后面才是 Lucy 自己的看法：总是帮你。「新来的」说的是烹饪班，不是老师。

options: He has a guitar lesson on the same day.
questions.explain: football… it's on Wednesdays, and I have my guitar lesson then——足球和吉他课撞在周三。太贵说的是烹饪班；踢得好不好没提。

questions.q: What did Lucy think of chess last year?
questions.explain: I found it really difficult, you have to think so hard! I stopped after three weeks——difficult = hard。「无聊」是别人对美术班的说法；「好玩」是表姐说烹饪班。

questions.q: Why isn't Sam going to do the cooking club?
options: It is on the wrong day.
questions.explain: It's on Fridays, which is fine, but it costs five pounds a week… That's too much for me——日子没问题，是钱的问题。喜不喜欢做饭没说。

sections.intro: 听 Lucy 告诉爸爸五个朋友各选了什么课外班。把每个人和右边 A-H 的班配起来。8 个班都会被提到，有 3 个没人选——注意听「谁最后选了什么」。

script.text: So, Lucy, did all your friends choose a club today?
Yes, Dad. Anna is doing dance. She already has dance lessons in town, so she'll be the best in the class.
That sounds right for her. What about Ben? He's good at football.
He is, but the football club was full. He's doing cooking. He says he wants to make pizza for his family.
Pizza! Nice. And Emma? She's your quiet friend, isn't she?
Yes. Emma chose chess. Her dad plays with her at home every evening, so she plays very well.
And Jack? I think he plays the guitar.
He does, but he has guitar lessons at home. At school he's doing science. They're going to learn about the stars and the planets.
That sounds interesting. And Rosa? Is she in the art club with you?
No, she wanted to, but she's doing swimming. Her mum says she needs more exercise.
Well, that's everyone. Now, tell me about your art club.

questions.explain: Anna is doing dance——直接说了。她在镇上上舞蹈课是补充信息。
He's good at football, but the football club was full. He's doing cooking——足球是干扰，最后选的是烹饪。
Emma chose chess——她爸爸每晚陪她下棋，所以她下得很好。
he plays the guitar, but he has guitar lessons at home. At school he's doing science——吉他是干扰，在学校选的是科学。
Is she in the art club? No… she's doing swimming——美术是干扰（那是 Lucy 自己的班），Rosa 选的是游泳。
